concept.title: Food when I cannot afford it
concept.shortdesc: As someone who cannot afford enough food, I need to find a food bank and how to get a referral or voucher, so that my household can eat.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-024). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Who: people on low incomes, people in crisis.
Situation: Access differs by provider: some need a voucher or referral.
A good result: Food banks in reach with opening times, whether a referral is needed and who can give one.
How much it matters: Important: a miss leaves someone without help they need.

ul.li: I can't afford to feed my family
how do I get a food bank voucher

section.p: Model-judged, in four places, with no human check yet. See for how to read it.
